title: First Night Cornell: Glow Silent Disco
description: Three DJ channels, a thousand glowing headphones, and the whole Class of 2030 dancing on the Barton Hall floor.

title: A Cappella Arch Sing
description: Cornell's a cappella groups trade sets under the arch. Bring a friend, sit on the grass, and find your new favorite group.

title: Big Red Welcome Fest & Food Truck Rally
description: A dozen Ithaca food trucks, lawn games, and free Big Red swag for the first 300 through the gate.

title: Libe Slope Sunset Acoustic Jam
description: Student songwriters play acoustic sets as the sun drops over Cayuga Lake. Blankets encouraged.

title: Club Fest Early Access & Swag Scramble
description: Get a first look at 500+ student orgs before the crowds, and grab stickers, tees, and tote bags while they last.

title: Collegetown Basement Showcase: Electric Buffalo Records
description: Student label Electric Buffalo Records brings four local bands to a packed Dryden Rd basement.

title: Midnight Bear Necessities Calzone Rush
description: North Campus's late-night calzone counter opens its doors. The line moves fast and the garlic knots go faster.

title: West Campus Midnight Pancake Slam
description: All-you-can-stack pancakes with a toppings bar, served by West Campus house professors.

title: Dairy Bar Ice Cream Crawl
description: Sample flights of Cornell Dairy flavors made on campus, including a Big Red Bear Tracks exclusive.

title: Beebe Lake Twilight Campfire & S'mores
description: Outdoor Odyssey leaders host a lakeside campfire with s'mores, stargazing, and ghost stories.

title: Klarman Atrium Late Night Board Games & Boba
description: Hundreds of board games under the glass atrium, with brown sugar boba on tap.

title: Collegetown Block Party & DJ Stage
description: Eddy St closes to traffic for a DJ stage, light rigs, and Collegetown food vendors until late.

title: VIP Big Red Welcome Concert
description: A headline act plays historic Bailey Hall for the official welcome concert. Reserved seating, limited tickets.

title: Cornell Cinema Secret 35mm Screening
description: The projectionists won't say what's on the reel until the lights go down. Real film, real popcorn.

title: Duffield Hall All-Nighter Hack & Caffeine Lab
description: Open hack space with mentors, cold brew, and snacks until 2 AM. Bring a laptop and an idea.

title: Ho Plaza Food Truck Alley
description: Ithaca favorites line Ho Plaza: Mexicali Grill, Silo Fried Chicken, and a waffle truck. Free to wander, pay as you eat.

title: Greek Row Welcome BBQ
description: Burgers, veggie dogs, and lawn games on Thurston Ave. Meet chapter members before rush starts.

title: Risley Theatre Midnight Rocky Horror
description: The legendary Risley shadow cast performs Rocky Horror. Prop bags at the door.

title: Morrison Dining Late-Night Waffles
description: Build-your-own waffle bar with fruit, Nutella, and Cornell Dairy whipped cream. Swipe in or pay at the door.

title: Botanic Gardens Firefly Walk
description: A guided twilight stroll through the Cornell Botanic Gardens with a naturalist.

title: Ithaca Commons Night Market
description: Local makers, crepes, and buskers line the pedestrian mall downtown.

title: Jazz on the Commons
description: Ithaca College and Cornell jazz combos trade sets at the Bernie Milton Pavilion.

title: Collegetown Bagels Night Owl Special
description: Half-price bagel sandwiches and cold brew for anyone with a student ID.

title: Big Red Marching Band Pep Rally
description: The Big Red Marching Band takes over Schoellkopf with the Alma Mater and fight songs.

title: Johnson Museum Rooftop Stargazing
description: Telescopes on the fifth-floor terrace with views over Cayuga Lake.

title: Rose House Open Mic Night
description: Poets, singer-songwriters, and comedians. Sign-up sheet opens at 7:45.

title: Becker House Karaoke Battle
description: House vs. house karaoke on West Campus. The winner gets the golden mic.

title: Gates Hall Hackathon Kickoff
description: Team formation, lightning talks, and free swag for the weekend hackathon.

title: Phillips Hall Robotics Showcase
description: Project teams demo autonomous rovers, drones, and a ping-pong robot.

title: Slope Day Throwback Glow Party
description: A Slope Day-themed glow party on a Collegetown rooftop. 18+, wristbands at the door.

title: Greek Row Neon Mixer
description: Neon paint, DJ sets, and a light tunnel on Ridgewood Rd. Wristband required.

title: Appel Late-Night Ramen Bar
description: Tonkotsu and veggie miso bowls at the Appel Commons counter.

title: Fall Creek Gorge Night Hike
description: Outdoor Odyssey leads a headlamp hike from the suspension bridge along the gorge rim.

title: Willard Straight Late-Night Trivia
description: Cornell history, pop culture, and Ithaca lore trivia in the Memorial Room.

title: Goldwin Smith Poetry Slam
description: Open slam on the Goldwin Smith steps. Judges are picked from the crowd.

title: Duffield Atrium 2 AM Pizza Drop
description: Fresh pizza for everyone still building at the Duffield all-nighter.
